editorial:
Imagine waking up to the worst news of your life and deciding that if you are going down, you are taking everyone else with you. That is exactly what Jeff does in this wild ride. After getting an AIDS diagnosis, he snaps and starts hunting random people across the city. Instead of a knife or a gun, he uses needles filled with his own blood to spread the virus. It is a dark, mean-spirited movie that feels like a nightmare you cannot wake up from. The vibe is very gritty and uncomfortable, making you feel the tension every time Jeff creeps up on a new victim.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you on edge with its fast pacing and creepy atmosphere. The acting is raw and makes Jeff feel genuinely dangerous. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the shock value is still high. If you love extreme thrillers that push the envelope, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, Jeff's spree catches up to him as the police close in. He tries to infect one last person, but he is caught in a struggle and accidentally pricks himself with a contaminated needle from another source. He dies in a state of total panic and irony. The movie ends with a bleak shot of the city, leaving you wondering how many people he actually managed to infect before he died.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves extreme underground horror and dark thrillers.
